summary: Examples show search matching a URL with a full pattern and also with a pattern from the middle of the string.
questions: How do I find /users/ in the middle of a URL with a regex test?

answer_card.title: search test examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
url: "https://example.com/users/foo/resources/bar"
foundmatch: url is search("https://example.com/users/.*/resources")  # True
alsomatch: url is search("users/.*/resources")                     # True
```
